primitives.note: Zeal: 6% bonus attack speed per basic attack, up to 5 stacks (30%), each stack lasting 5s and refreshing on attack.
Zealous at level 1, ranged form at 6, Aflame fire wave (P) and explosion bonus on E's active at 11, permanent max Zeal at 16.
P's Aflame fire wave rides every qualifying attack while Exalted; E's passive adds bonus magic damage to every basic attack.
P's fire wave and E's Aflame explosion are both explicitly affected by critical strike modifiers.
E's active arms Kayle's next basic attack with extra on-hit magic damage based on the target's missing health.
Starfire Spellblade resets Kayle's basic attack timer.
E's active bonus damage scales with the target's current missing health (plus a per-100-AP ratio).
Q inflicts a 15% armor/magic resistance shred (Sundered) for 4 seconds on everything it hits.
Q's damage lands on a fixed 0.25s delay from cast start; R's damage lands 2.5s after cast start. Both are on-cooldown casts, no further tracking after cast.
Both cost mana (Q 60-100, R 100/50/0); whether this binds inside a 15s fight depends on level/items and on Q's unexplained 50% mana refund (see unsettled).
Q is a skillshot missile assumed to always connect; R's damage falls around its target (Kayle if self-cast) and is assumed to always reach the dummy standing next to her.
W is a pure heal plus move-speed buff with no damage; irrelevant to a damage-only dummy fight.

needsBespoke.why: Every damage-relevant mechanic maps onto an existing primitive and the value schema's term types (in particular the targetMissingHp term covers E's execute-style scaling); what remains is just timing bookkeeping (cast delays, buff durations, a post-effect cooldown start) that ordinary cooldown/duration tracking should already support.

unsettled.question: Does Radiant Blast's cast time scale with Kayle's attack speed (the wiki's main documented behavior, windup percent 0.193555 / total attack speed), or is it a flat 0.25s (matching the bin's castTime field)?
options: Scales with attack speed: 0.30968s at base AS, up to 0.96775s at 0.2 AS, down to 0.06445s at the 3.003 AS cap
Flat 0.25s regardless of attack speed, per the bin and the ability's pre-V10.4 behavior
quotes: The cast time can be calculated by dividing '''Kayle's''' ''windup percent'' value ({{fd|0.193555}}) with her current total attack speed.

in patch [[V9.17]], ''Radiant Blast's'' cast time was changed to be a flat {{fd|0.25}} seconds, rather than scaling with the attack windup time. In patch [[V10.4]], this was undocumentedly changed back. Whether the change to scale with windup time again was intentional or not is unknown.

unsettled.question: In a single-target fight, does Starfire Spellblade's Aflame explosion (level 11+) deal a second instance of the active's damage to the dummy itself (the only 'surrounding enemy'), or does it only ever reach additional enemies beyond the main target (a no-op with one target)?
options: The explosion re-hits the same, only target for a second full instance of the active's damage
The explosion only extends to other enemies beyond the main target, so it adds nothing in a single-target fight
quotes: The attack explodes upon the target, dealing its damage to surrounding enemies and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects. This is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

unsettled.question: When Kayle is Exalted and level 11+, does the E-empowered basic attack also count as a qualifying attack for P's Aflame fire wave, so one auto-attack lands base attack damage + E's on-hit (passive and active) + the fire wave together?
options: Yes: the fire wave and E's active both key off 'a basic attack while Exalted' independently and both fire on the same attack
They are mutually exclusive or otherwise interact on the same attack in a way neither ability's text states
quotes: While '''Kayle''' is ''Exalted'', her basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} also launch a ''wave'' of fire forward
'''Kayle''' kindles her blade, empowering her next [[basic attack]] within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal additional {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}

unsettled.question: How long does Starfire Spellblade's active empowerment actually last on Kayle's next basic attack: the wiki's 6 seconds, or the bin's KayleE.BuffDuration of 5?
quotes: empowering her next [[basic attack]] within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}

unsettled.question: What triggers Radiant Blast's undocumented 50% mana refund (KayleQ.ManaRefundPercent), and does it apply inside a 15s dummy fight?
options: It refunds 50% of Q's mana cost on some condition (e.g. on hit), effectively halving Q's sustained mana cost
It is unused or conditioned on something that never happens in this fight (e.g. only refunds on a miss, which cannot occur against a stationary dummy), so it never applies here

unsettled.question: What does Starfire Spellblade's 0.1s queue time actually gate: a real delay before the empowerment attaches to the next attack, or just an input-buffer technicality with no timing effect?
options: A real 0.1s delay before the active's empowerment becomes attached to the next attack
Purely an input-queue technicality with no effect on when damage can land

proposal: Self-cast R (Divine Judgment) immediately at the start of the fight for its unconditional magic damage burst; its invulnerability grant has no use against a dummy that never attacks back.
Activate E's active (Starfire Spellblade) as soon as it comes off cooldown, timed right before the next basic attack, so the empowered on-hit damage is never wasted waiting out its window.

Auto-attack continuously with no gaps, to build and hold 5 stacks of Zeal for +30% bonus attack speed, and, from level 11 onward while Exalted, to keep triggering the Aflame fire wave on every attack.
Cast Q (Radiant Blast) on cooldown throughout the fight, both for its direct magic damage and to keep the target's armor/magic resistance shredded (Sundered) as continuously as possible.
Never cast W (Celestial Blessing): it deals no damage and only heals/speeds up allies, who do not exist and would not matter in this fight.
questions: Does the E-empowered attack also trigger P's fire wave on the same swing (see unsettled), which would change whether E should be timed to land before or after reaching 5 Zeal stacks?
Should R be cast at the very start (to land its damage earliest, for a faster kill time) or does timing not matter since its cooldown will never come back up within 15s either way?
Does Radiant Blast's cast time actually shrink with attack speed (see unsettled), which would change how tightly it can be weaved between auto-attacks and E activations?
Does Q's mana refund change how aggressively Q can be cast on cooldown at low levels/mana pools before mana becomes a limiter?
